# Path and Tooling Variations

Never assume binaries reside in `/bin` vs `/usr/bin` vs `/sbin`. Always verify executable presence with `command -v`:

```bash
if ! command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "Error: curl is required but not installed." >&2
    exit 1
fi
```
